headline: Otto found $62,880/year in SaaS waste in Acme AI Studio's stack
tagline: The agent that audits SaaS spend, finds waste, and bills only when it saves money.
thesis: SaaS bloat is a better hackathon business target because the pain is universal, the savings are visible, and the Stripe success-fee loop is native.

recommendations.action: Retire New Relic after Datadog migration
recommendations.why: New Relic has 20% utilization and duplicates Datadog.

recommendations.action: Cancel Monday.com and consolidate project work into Asana
recommendations.why: Monday.com has 29% utilization and overlaps with Asana.

recommendations.action: Right-size Figma paid editor seats from 54 to 30
recommendations.why: Viewer-only behavior on paid editor seats; keep designers and PM editors.

recommendations.action: Retire Zendesk and route remaining queues to Intercom
recommendations.why: Zendesk has 25% utilization and duplicates Intercom.

recommendations.action: Downgrade Zoom licenses to external-facing teams only
recommendations.why: Only 39 of 70 seats active; internal calls shifted to Google Meet.

recommendations.action: Close Dropbox legacy storage after Google Drive migration
recommendations.why: Dropbox has 18% utilization after Google Drive rollout.

recommendations.action: Reduce Loom, Calendly, Airtable, Miro, Lucidchart unused seats
recommendations.why: Low-utilization collaboration tools with clear owner groups.

provisioning_actions.step: Open cancellation workflow for New Relic monthly plan
Generate Monday.com to Asana migration checklist
Draft Figma seat true-up CSV for procurement admin
Prepare Stripe success-fee checkout for approved savings audit

council_transcript.position: Prioritize duplicate systems and contractual timing; avoid cutting security and identity tools.
Rank each recommendation by implementation risk, buyer effort, and visible annualized savings.

council_transcript.model: Reference 3 - Nemotron 3 Ultra via Ollama Cloud
council_transcript.position: Risk-review procurement actions and block unsafe cuts without legal-hold, rollback, and human-approval controls.
Approved seven recommendations with high savings, low operational risk, clear Stripe success-fee economics, and Nemotron risk review.
